Christopher Vance
Operations Manager
Chicago, IL | christopher.vance@email.com | +1 555-019-3311 | linkedin.com/in/cvance-ops

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Operations Manager with 9 years of experience driving process improvement, supply chain optimization, team leadership, and cost reduction. Certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt adept at KPI Management, vendor negotiations, and ERP system implementations. Achieved $850K in annual operational cost savings and increased team productivity by 32%.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Operations Manager | Global Logistics Corp | Chicago, IL | 2020 - Present
- Managed daily operations for a 45,000 sq ft logistics facility and led a cross-functional team of 25 staff members.
- Implemented Lean Six Sigma methodology across fulfillment workflows, reducing process cycle time by 40% and cutting operational expenses by $850K annually.
- Overhauled SLA performance tracking, elevating customer order delivery SLA compliance from 91% to 99.4%.
- Negotiated strategic vendor management contracts with 12 major freight carriers, saving 15% on logistics costs.
- Spearheaded integration of SAP ERP software to streamline inventory management and real-time stock tracking.

Operations Supervisor | Apex Manufacturing | Chicago, IL | 2015 - 2020
- Supervised production scheduling, inventory control, and quality assurance protocols.
- Introduced continuous process improvement initiatives that boosted overall team productivity by 32% within 12 months.
- Reduced warehouse safety incidents to zero over a 2-year period.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Industrial Engineering | Purdue University | 2011 - 2015

CERTIFICATIONS & SKILLS
- Certifications: Certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (LSSBB), APICS Certified in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM)
- Core Competencies: Operations Management, Process Improvement, Lean, Six Sigma, KPI Management, Supply Chain, Vendor Management, Cost Optimization, Team Leadership, Advanced Excel, SAP ERP
